method: Direct public-page reading after all 18 answers were collected. Linked context verifies ownership; it is not added as holdout evidence.

selected_pages.title: About LearningAIsearch.com
selected_pages.selection_reason: Most recurrent own-content citation; tracking parameters collapsed for page selection only.
selected_pages.byline: Site explicitly attributes creation and funding to Aleyda Solis.
evidence: Explains a free curated roadmap and an editorial submission process; declares no advertising or paid inclusion. This is a policy statement, not an original GEO experiment.
selected_pages.content_strategy: Explicit author identity and editorial policy connected to the learning roadmap.
reusable: Publish clear authorship and resource-selection criteria.
background_advantages: An established consultant funds ongoing curation; a beginner cannot assume equivalent reputation.
limitations: A cited About page authenticates identity; it does not validate every linked guide or prove recommendation causation.

selected_pages.title: The Free AI Search Optimization Roadmap
selected_pages.selection_reason: Actual homepage body hyperlink shows the learning asset itself, beyond the recurrent About page.
evidence: Version 4 is dated March 20, 2026. Topic navigation spans fundamentals, measurement, commerce and tools; a copyable checklist and FAQs support action. No controlled original experiment appears on this hub.
selected_pages.content_strategy: A versioned hub links user questions to specialist pages and a practical checklist.

third_party_distribution.evidence: Frank Chiu's course comparison names and links the roadmap. This page also supports Grok Q1 R1's recommendation through a third-party citation.

reusable: Create a small question-based hub; link each lesson to evidence and a free checklist.
background_advantages: Existing expert and newsletter connections are not reproduced by copying the layout.
limitations: Curation depth depends on external resources. The visible revision date does not prove every item is current; this audit does not endorse all optimization advice.

selected_pages.title: Optimize for AI Search (GEO, AEO, LLMO)
selected_pages.selection_reason: A distinct body-cited asset whose creator attribution needed independent verification.
selected_pages.byline: LearningSEO.io About page identifies Aleyda as its founder and curator; individual linked resources have their own authors.
evidence: Six topic sections distinguish research, guides, official documentation and tools, naming individual authors. It curates evidence rather than presenting one unified original experiment.
selected_pages.content_strategy: An AI-search section sits within a broader SEO learning system.

internal_links.label: Ownership verification context; not a holdout citation

third_party_distribution.evidence: A podcast interviews Aleyda about creating LearningSEO.io and links to it. This is a distribution example, not evidence about the current AI page's search ranking.

reusable: Label resource types and credit original authors; connect specialist pages to a central index.
background_advantages: The interview describes SEO work beginning in 2007; that experience is self-reported background.
limitations: LearningSEO.io was added to the asset registry after ownership verification. It remains distinct from LearningAIsearch.com.

attribution_resolution.note: First-party About page independently confirms founder/curator identity. Count the owned curated page as C, not all external linked articles as Aleyda-authored work.

notes: All three selected URLs were actual body hyperlinks. Frank Chiu and the podcast are external distribution evidence; their presence does not establish how either tested environment found Aleyda.

hypotheses.practice: A question-based learning index with clear authorship and free practical assets
hypotheses.evidence: Observed roadmap, topic links and checklist; candidate was recommended in Q1 and Q3.
hypotheses.next_test: Publish a small indexed collection, keep matched prompts and repeated baselines fixed, and compare discovery before and after over multiple dates.
hypotheses.causal_status: Candidate hypothesis; no content intervention in this study.
